posts.title: News From the Road: November 12, 2026
posts.description: What's Shakin'? Winter is starting to show its face here in the panhandle, and I could not be more excited. I would not say that my house is ready for winter, and I have some cleaning and organizing projects I would like to get done before I go into full hibernation mode for the season, but for now I am just enjoying the chill in the air and looking forward to the first snowfall.
